priority_label_set={'priority-1','priority-2','priority-3'}

# Verification pass (single): re-fetch remaining read, unstarred threads in inbox/outbox and compute how many would still match deletion criteria.

# Fetch all read inbox threads, unstarred
inbox_remaining=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=gmail_token, read=True, starred=False, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    inbox_remaining.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Fetch all read outbox threads, unstarred
outbox_remaining=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.gmail.show_outbox_threads(access_token=gmail_token, read=True, starred=False, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    outbox_remaining.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('inbox_remaining_count:', len(inbox_remaining))
print('outbox_remaining_count:', len(outbox_remaining))

from collections import Counter
print('inbox_remaining_label_distribution:', Counter([t.get('label') for t in inbox_remaining]).most_common())
print('outbox_remaining_label_distribution:', Counter([t.get('label') for t in outbox_remaining]).most_common())

# Count remaining that are NOT priority-labeled (label is None or other) -> should be zero
inbox_should_be_deleted = [t for t in inbox_remaining if t.get('label') not in priority_label_set]
outbox_should_be_deleted = [t for t in outbox_remaining if t.get('label') not in priority_label_set]

print('inbox_should_be_deleted_count:', len(inbox_should_be_deleted))
print('outbox_should_be_deleted_count:', len(outbox_should_be_deleted))
print('inbox_should_be_deleted_ids:', [t['email_thread_id'] for t in inbox_should_be_deleted])
print('outbox_should_be_deleted_ids:', [t['email_thread_id'] for t in outbox_should_be_deleted])

remaining_to_delete_ids = sorted(set([t['email_thread_id'] for t in inbox_should_be_deleted]+[t['email_thread_id'] for t in outbox_should_be_deleted]))
print('remaining_to_delete_unique_count:', len(remaining_to_delete_ids))
